I have two Jira search result files saved to disk. Each is JSON with schema {result: string} where the `result` string contains a JSON array of Jira issues (or a text representation). I need you to extract and summarize every issue relevant to MuleSoft and/or Order Management (OMS) for an upcoming project meeting.

Files:
1. /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/.claude/projects/-Users-marcel-a-n-navarro-Dev-zimmermann-pwa/5e37053f-2278-4157-ae9c-9bd2acb32a6e/tool-results/mcp-mcp-atlassian-jira_search-1784696463236.txt  (results of text ~ "MuleSoft" search)
2. /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/.claude/projects/-Users-marcel-a-n-navarro-Dev-zimmermann-pwa/5e37053f-2278-4157-ae9c-9bd2acb32a6e/tool-results/mcp-mcp-atlassian-jira_search-1784696463191.txt  (results of text ~ "order management" OR "OMS" search)

Instructions:
- First probe the structure with jq (type/length/keys) — e.g. `jq '.result | fromjson | type, length' <file>` (the `result` value is itself a JSON string that needs a second parse; if `fromjson` fails, inspect the raw string).
- Then extract and read the content in full with jq or python. Do NOT try to Read the whole file into a chat tool — use jq/python from the shell.
- For EACH relevant issue, report: issue key (e.g. SFCC-NNN), issue type (Story/Task/Bug/Epic/Spike), summary/title, status, priority, assignee, and a 1-2 sentence extract of the description if it mentions MuleSoft, NewStore, OMS, order creation, order history, order detail, order status, returns, fulfilment, or checkout→order flow.
- Group them by theme: (a) Create Order / order submission, (b) Order History & Detail / My Account, (c) Returns/refunds/cancellations, (d) Fulfilment/delivery/shipment/tracking, (e) Spikes/investigations, (f) anything else MuleSoft-related.
- Note the current status distribution (how many To Do vs In Progress vs Done) for order-management work.
- Call out any issues explicitly flagged as blocked, or whose description contains open questions, TBDs, "confirm with", "pending", or dependencies on MuleSoft/NewStore.
- Deduplicate — the two files likely overlap.

Return a structured, detailed markdown report. Quote key finding text verbatim where it matters. This is read-only research — do not modify anything.
